question_text: Will Curtis Sliwa concede defeat in the 2025 New York City mayoral election before Nov 5, 2025?
resolution_criteria:
If Curtis Sliwa has made a statement conceding defeat in the 2025 New York City mayoral election before Nov 5, 2025, then the market resolves to Yes.
A concession requires Curtis Sliwa to explicitly acknowledge defeat, loss, or that their opponent has won 2025 New York City mayoral election. This may include statements using words such as "concede," "congratulate [opponent] on their victory," "accept the results," "will not be [office holder]" or other unambiguous acknowledgments of defeat.
